  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here, officer, flextable, sf)

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L1/101_get_ETF_EPT_images.qmd")

# Read data


```{r}
#| label: read-obs-data
# Get raw EPT data from iNat API
EPT <- c("ephemeroptera", "plecoptera", "trichoptera")

all_spp_ids <- list()

for (spp in seq_along(EPT)) {
  # read in data
  spp_data <- readRDS(here(
    L0_data_dir,
    paste0("001", letters[spp], "_obs_", EPT[spp], ".rds")
  ))

  all_spp_ids[[spp]] <- spp_data

  rm(spp_data)
  gc()
}
combined_ids <- bind_rows(all_spp_ids) # 615,756 rows
rm(all_spp_ids)

# Filter down to only EPT obs within study extent
clean_ETF_EPT <- read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "004_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.csv")) |>
  inner_join(combined_ids, by = c("id", "taxon.name")) |>
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Save temp file
saveRDS(
  clean_ETF_EPT,
  file = here(L1_data_dir, "101a_images_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.rds")
)

rm(combined_ids)
gc()
```


```{r}
#| label: read-temp-file
clean_ETF_EPT <- readRDS(here(
  L1_data_dir,
  "101a_images_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.rds"
))
```


# Download EPT images

https://registry.opendata.aws/inaturalist-open-data/

https://github.com/inaturalist/inaturalist-open-data/tree/documentation


```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
#### Write a functino to download all images for each observation
# Create separate folder for each taxon order
# each pic should be "spp_obs_#######_1/2/3.jpg", where:
# > spp is the initial of the insect order (e.g., E, P, T)
# > ##### is the number of the observation
# > 1/2/3 is the image num. associated with the obs (if multiple imgs per obs)

#dest_file <- file.path(download_dir, paste0(spp, "obs_", id, "_", x, ".jpg"))

# Create export directories
image_path <- file.path("data", "L2", "101c_ETF_EPT_images")
image_dir <- here(image_path)
e_dir <- here(image_path, "ephe_imgs")
p_dir <- here(image_path, "plec_imgs")
t_dir <- here(image_path, "tric_imgs")
dir_list <- c(image_dir, e_dir, p_dir, t_dir)
ept_dirs <- c(e_dir, p_dir, t_dir)

for (dir in seq_along(dir_list)) {
  if (!file.exists(dir_list[dir])) {
    dir.create(dir_list[dir])
    cat(sprintf("\nThe following directory was created: %s", dir_list[dir]))
  }
}

# iNat Taxon ID
EPT_id <- c("48011", "47504", "62164")
EPT <- c("ephemeroptera", "plecoptera", "trichoptera")

MakePattern <- function(data) {
  string <- paste0("(^|,|/)", data, "(,|/|$)")
}


processed_data <- clean_ETF_EPT |>
  mutate(
    # Determine taxa order classification
    species_label = case_when(
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[1] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[1])) ~ EPT[1],
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[2] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[2])) ~ EPT[2],
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[3] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[3])) ~ EPT[3],
      .default = NA_character_
    ),
    # Determine export directory
    save_dir = case_when(
      species_label == EPT[1] ~ ept_dirs[1],
      species_label == EPT[2] ~ ept_dirs[2],
      species_label == EPT[3] ~ ept_dirs[3],
      TRUE ~ image_dir # Fallback directory
    )
  ) |>
  # Expand the photos
  unnest(observation_photos, names_sep = ".") |>
  # Update url and create the export filename
  mutate(
    clean_url = str_replace(observation_photos.photo.url, "square", "small"),
    img_name = paste0(
      str_to_upper(substr(species_label, 1, 1)),
      "_obs",
      id,
      "_img",
      observation_photos.id,
      "_",
      observation_photos.position,
      ".jpg"
    ),
    save_dir = paste0(save_dir, "/", img_name)
  ) |>
  # Only keep relevant columns
  select(
    id,
    species_label,
    clean_url,
    img_name,
    save_dir,
    contains("observation_photos")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: explore-data
# -- Check out one ID - see multiple rows of images per observation ID :)
processed_data |>
  filter(id == 324828906) |>
  glimpse()

# --- Check license_codes for individual images to ensure they haven't been
# changed from the observation license "observation_photos.photo.license_code" check
# - table Numbers will be different due to more rows of images in processed_data
clean_ETF_EPT |> select(license_code) |> table()
processed_data |> select(observation_photos.photo.license_code) |> table()
# - check for license codes that we DONT want
processed_data |>
  filter(
    !observation_photos.photo.license_code %in% c("cc-by", "cc-by-nc", "cc0")
  )

# --- Check for flagged images "observation_photos.photo.flags"
processed_data |> filter(length(observation_photos.photo.flags) == 0)

# -- Check for urls not in the AWS open dataset
processed_data |> filter(!str_detect(clean_url, "inaturalist-open-data"))

# --- Check for "all rights reserved"
# Observations with photo NA license codes get assigned "all rights reserved"
# despite the observation license_code field being assigned cc-by, cc-by-nc, or cc0
processed_data |>
  filter(str_detect(
    observation_photos.photo.attribution,
    "all rights reserved"
  ))
processed_data |> filter(is.na(observation_photos.photo.license_code))
look <- clean_ETF_EPT |> filter(id == "325739000")

# Clean up data
final_data <- processed_data |>
  filter(
    observation_photos.photo.license_code %in% c("cc-by", "cc-by-nc", "cc0")
  ) |>
  filter(str_detect(clean_url, "inaturalist-open-data")) |>
  filter(
    !str_detect(observation_photos.photo.attribution, "all rights reserved")
  ) |>
  select(-contains("observation_photos"))

rm(processed_data, clean_ETF_EPT, look)
gc()
```

```{r}
#| label: save-data
# Save the final dataset
write_csv(final_data, here(L1_data_dir, "101b_images_metadata_ETF_EPT.csv"))
```


```{r}
#| label: download-data
# Create log file
log_file <- here(
  L1_data_dir,
  "101c_ETF_EPT_images",
  "download_log.txt"
)
if (!file.exists(log_file)) {
  file.create(log_file)
}

## iteratte over columns to download photos
final_data |>
  pwalk(function(clean_url, save_dir, id, ...) {
    # Skip if image already downloaded
    if (file.exists(save_dir)) {
      write(
        paste0(Sys.time(), " | SKIP | ", id),
        file = log_file,
        append = TRUE
      )
      return(NULL)
    }

    # Try downloading image
    tryCatch(
      {
        download.file(
          url = clean_url,
          destfile = save_dir,
          mode = "wb",
          quiet = TRUE
        )
        # write to log
        write(
          paste0(Sys.time(), " | SUCCESS | ", id),
          file = log_file,
          append = TRUE
        )
        Sys.sleep(0.1) # tiny sleep
      },
      error = function(e) {
        # Log the error with a timestamp
        write(
          paste0(Sys.time(), " | FAIL | ", id, " | ", clean_url),
          file = log_file,
          append = TRUE
        )
      }
    )
  })
```

# download skipped files


```{r}
#| label: read-log
# I have two logs files with different names, so this reads in all/any log files

files <- dir(here(L1_data_dir, "101c_ETF_EPT_images"))

# Read in any log files
all_logs <- tibble(file_path = files) |>
  filter(str_detect(file_path, "download_log.*\\.txt")) |>
  mutate(log_name = fs::path_file(file_path)) |>
  mutate(
    data = map(
      file_path,
      ~ {
        # Read as raw lines
        tibble(
          raw_text = read_lines(here(
            L1_data_dir,
            "101c_ETF_EPT_images",
            .x
          ))
        ) |>
          separate_wider_delim(
            cols = raw_text,
            delim = "|",
            names = c("timestamp", "status", "id", "other"),
            too_few = "align_start",
            too_many = "merge"
          ) |>
          mutate(across(everything(), trimws))
      }
    )
  ) |>
  select(log_name, data) |>
  unnest(cols = c(data))


# See success vs failure counts
all_logs |> group_by(log_name) |> count(status)

# 37 observations failed to download

failed <- all_logs |>
  filter(
    status == "FAIL" & log_name == "download_log_05_25_2026_rerun_skips.txt"
  ) |>
  distinct()

# Upon examining a small sample of these observations,
# they are not downloading because the licensing to the observation
# has changed since the observation metadata was pulled from the
# iNat API in early 2026.
# For example, observation ID #165636469 has a cc-by-nc license
clean_ETF_EPT |> filter(id == 165636469) |> select(license_code)
# However, when examinign this observation on iNaturalist,
# the observation is covered by the user with "all rights reserved":
# https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/165636469
```





# Download single image
```{r}
#| label: dwnld-image
#### Try downloading one image - works!

obs_data <- clean_ETF_EPT[1, ]

rm(all_spp_ids)
# 4. Extract the URL and Observation ID
target_url <- obs_data |>
  select(observation_photos) |>
  unnest(observation_photos)
target_url <- target_url$photo.url[1]
obs_id <- obs_data$id[1]

# 5. Clean the URL
# Standard sizes: small, medium, large, original
clean_url <- gsub("square", "small", target_url)

# 6. Download the image
dest_file <- paste0("observation_", obs_id, ".jpg")

tryCatch(
  {
    download.file(clean_url, destfile = dest_file, mode = "wb")
    message("Successfully downloaded observation ", obs_id, " to ", dest_file)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message(
      "Failed to download."
    )
  }
)
```
